brief:
Resistance committees in Palestine marked the first anniversary of Abu Ubaida's death, asserting that his killing failed to silence his message, Shehab Wire reported. The committees stressed that the Palestinian cause will remain present despite attempts to obscure it.

The statement emphasized that blood serves as evidence of the people's commitment to their rights. The committees said the assassination did not succeed in breaking the resolve of Palestinians or deterring the continuation of resistance activities. They reiterated their commitment to carrying forward the work and principles associated with Abu Ubaida, maintaining that his legacy will persist through ongoing struggle.
